analyst_view.overall: Espanyol (11th, 15 points) host Getafe (18th, 12 points) on Monday night in a game between sides three points apart near the bottom; the numbers lean to a home win in a tight, low-scoring game of about 1.8 goals with plenty of cards. Eder Sarabia's Espanyol have taken 7 of the last 9 points, including a 1-0 win at San Mamés, with three straight clean sheets; Riedel is suspended and Calatrava and Kike García are out, while Edu Expósito (counted as out) and Urko González are doubts rather than ruled out, helped by the Monday date. Getafe have lost their last two at home, including 3-0 to Atlético, and one report says they have neither won nor scored in six away league games; they miss Djené (red card, counted), Carvajal and Uche, with Boselli doubtful, while Gudelj returns from a ban and Zaid Romero is fit. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.8 goals, already low because Getafe have scored only three in their last six and Espanyol have kept three clean sheets. They take a little off Espanyol for Edu Expósito, who is now only a doubt, and add a little for Djené's ban; that small difference is not worth a move, so I stay at 1.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners, already raising Getafe's share because Espanyol have conceded many corners lately (50 in six). Espanyol's wing-backs Hinojo and El Hilali push wide, but nothing in the news changes the picture; I stay at about 9.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.7 cards, already high and raised for both sides' recent bookings (+5.4% Espanyol, +10.3% Getafe). Two sides near the drop zone and Getafe's physical style point to a scrappy game, but that is exactly what the numbers already expect, and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 6.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.6 shots, already lower for Espanyol's low recent shooting (52 in six). Getafe allow plenty of shots, and Espanyol's attack relies on Roberto Fernández (7 goals), but none of this is news to the numbers, so I stay at about 23.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.4 shots on target, already lowered for Getafe's poor recent accuracy (17 on target in six) with Satriano their top scorer on three. Nothing in the team news changes that, so I stay at 7.4.
